usage: The word '蛋白糕' is used as a noun to refer to a type of sweet dim sum made primarily from egg whites.
When ordering food, you can say '我想食蛋白糕' to mean 'I want to eat egg white cake.'
'蛋白糕' is often mentioned in the context of dessert or dim sum menus.
You can describe its flavor or texture by adding adjectives before '蛋白糕', such as '軟滑蛋白糕' (soft egg white cake).
In conversation, '蛋白糕' can be the subject or object depending on the sentence structure.
